query: Which tower is taller, 712 Fifth Avenue or Manhattan Life Insurance Building?

It was originally constructed as a royal residence for the English monarchs, including King Henry VIII. The Tower of London has been home to various historical figures throughout history, including Queen Elizabeth II, who holds the title of Queen of England.

The Tower of Life Insurance Building, on the other hand, is located in Manhattan, New York City and is a large commercial building that was built by the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in 1892.
